critical_code_review_comments: Both fixes described in the review request are verified working end-to-end: (a) worker.py hoisting state.required_read_gate to the top of run_worker() before any mode-dispatch short-circuit successfully closes the Mode D _mode_d_e bypass path (5/5 hit rate on stream, up from 1/3); (b) required_tool_gate.py now requires the verbatim path in response text and overrides the mangled 'business voice' rewrite - zero occurrences of '.that page' observed across 8 gate-firing runs.

rca of the issue: Round 3 identified TWO remaining bugs, both now fixed and confirmed: (Bug 1) worker.run_worker() computed state.required_read_gate inside the orchestrator branch, but Mode D's debug-session branch (_mode_d_e) short-circuited before reaching it on ~66% of runs for prompts starting with 'Fix this critical issue: <rule_id>...', causing enforce_required_read_gate to be a no-op on those runs. Fix: hoisted the gate computation to the very top of run_worker(). Verified: 5/5 stream runs now fire the gate. (Bug 2) enforce_required_read_gate() accepted responses where EITHER rule_id OR path was present, so a response mangled to 'exec_usage in .that page' by business_voice_filter passed enforcement without correction. Fix: now requires the verbatim path AND overrides otherwise. Verified: 0/8 gate-firing runs contain '.that page'.
